_readme.what: Client database for the Roof Assistant AI receptionist. One entry per client, keyed by client_id.
_readme.how_to_add_a_client: Copy a client block, give it a new unique key, set the same value in client_id, push/deploy. The client's snippet uses data-client-id="<that key>".

fields.client_id: REQUIRED. Unique key. Must match the object key and data-client-id in the client's script tag.
fields.company_name: REQUIRED. Shown in the header and greeting, and used by the AI.
fields.city: Recommended. City/area the AI says the company is in, e.g. 'Orlando, Florida'.
fields.primary_color: "auto" (default) = the bot copies the brand colour of the website it is installed on. Or a fixed hex colour like "#ea580c". Text colour on top is picked automatically.
fields.fallback_color: Colour used when "auto" can't find a brand colour on the website.
fields.email: Where leads are emailed (free FormSubmit relay). The client confirms once on the first lead.
fields.webhook_url: Optional. Lead JSON is also POSTed here (their CRM, Zapier, etc.). Leave empty to skip.
fields.allowed_domains: Domain lock. Widget and AI only work on these domains (+ subdomains). localhost always works for testing.
fields.services: The quick-reply service buttons (max 4). Emoji at the start is optional.
fields.business_info: FACTS the AI may use to answer questions (areas served, insurance, financing, licenses). The AI is told never to invent anything not written here. Only write what is TRUE for this client.
fields.ai_enabled: true = AI answers typed questions. false = scripted flow only (free plan tier).
fields.ai_max_turns: Max AI replies per conversation before switching to the script (cost/abuse protection).
fields.greeting: Optional custom first message. Default greets with company name and the three services.
fields.logo_url: Optional square image for the header. Falls back to initials.
fields.teaser_text: Small nudge bubble above the launcher (appears with 'typing' dots). Empty string disables it.
fields.teaser_delay_ms: How long after page load the teaser appears (milliseconds).
fields.attention_effects: true = the chat bubble pops in and wiggles until opened. false = calm.
fields.sound: true = soft chime with the teaser (once the visitor has clicked/tapped the page; browsers block sound before that) and a quiet pop on bot replies. false = silent.
fields.footer_text: Small trust line under the chat. {company} is replaced with company_name.
fields.active: false switches a client off instantly (widget and AI).
